The test image shows a whole field view of soybean plants with widespread interveinal yellowing/chlorosis on leaves — green veins visible against yellow leaf tissue. This strongly points toward leaf diseases causing interveinal chlorosis. Top candidates: Sudden_death_syndrome, Downy_mildew, Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus, Brown_Stem_Rot.

Let me view reference images one at a time.
SDS reference shows interveinal chlorosis with yellow/purple blotches between veins — similar pattern to what I see in the test image. Let me check Downy mildew.
Downy mildew shows small isolated yellow spots on green leaves — doesn't match the widespread interveinal yellowing in the test image. Let me check Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus.
Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus shows green-yellow mottling but more subtle. Let me check Brown_Stem_Rot leaves.
Brown_Stem_Rot shows severe brown necrosis between green veins — more advanced than the test image. Let me continue with other candidates.

This is a very strong match! The Soybean_Cyst_Nematode leaf reference shows almost identical appearance to the test image — same wide field view, same yellow-margin/green-center pattern across many plants. Let me continue checking other candidates.
Not a match — bacterial blight shows isolated small angular spots on green leaves. Continuing.
14 images viewed so far. Need 2 more to reach 16. Let me check Tobacco_Streak_Virus and one more.

I've now viewed all 16 reference images. 

**Summary of findings:**

- **Soybean_Cyst_Nematode** (leaf/19): Near-identical match — same wide field/canopy view, same pattern of yellow-margined leaves with green centers, same overall yellow-green appearance across many plants.
- **Sudden_death_syndrome**: Shows interveinal chlorosis/brown necrosis on individual leaves — close-up shots, more necrotic, doesn't match the field-level yellow-margin pattern.
- All others (Downy mildew, Bean Pod Mottle, Brown Stem Rot, Bacterial Blight, Bacterial Pustule, Cercospora, Frogeye, Powdery Mildew, Septoria, Vein Necrosis, Soybean Rust, Anthracnose, Phyllosticta, Tobacco Streak Virus): all show spot-based lesions, white powder, brown spots, or stem symptoms — none match the widespread interveinal/marginal yellowing field view.

The SCN reference image is compositionally almost identical to the test image — same field-level canopy view, same yellow-on-leaf-margins pattern spreading across many plants.
